name: wARS
who_can_redeem: Ripio product material supports conversion between wARS and Argentine pesos for eligible Ripio users; a separate direct legal redemption right against the exact issuing entity is not established by the reviewed public sources.
redemption_region_notes: World Money separately documents an Argentina ARS-to-wARS virtual-account route for eligible Ripio users with local residency and verification requirements.
redemption_notes: Platform conversion is recorded separately from direct issuer redemption. Exact holder claim, issuing legal entity and insolvency treatment remain unresolved.
summary: Argentine-peso-referenced member of Ripio's wFIAT local-stablecoin suite, backed 1:1 by peso-denominated reserves according to Ripio and distributed across multiple EVM networks and consumer wallet rails.
notes: The earliest dated lifecycle milestone promoted here is the first wARS mint on World Chain on 2025-05-21; SOG does not convert that network-specific milestone into an invented global launch date. Ripio is used as the compatibility issuer/operator identity while the exact legal issuing entity remains an explicit known unknown.
